card.name: Just before a document's opening section
card.fires_on: Punctuation or numbering right before the first section of a document or heading, such as the "1." or "10.1" before a first subsection, or the end of a man-page title line. It also fires in text describing document sections.

modes.label: Man page headers
modes.description: The closing parenthesis or text of a Linux manual page title, just before the NAME or SYNOPSIS section.
modes.example: TMPFILE(3) Linux Programmer's Manual TMPFILE(3<<)>> NAME tmpfile - create a temporary file

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: The number or period in a heading like 1. or 10.1 that is followed by the first subsection title.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE 10.<<1>> Signs and Symptoms DULERA: D

modes.label: Describing document sections
modes.description: Text that lists or explains what sections a document has, such as conclusion or head sections.
modes.example: Each page is divided into the following sections: <<->> head with command name and section’s number

card.writes: It pushes toward words like introduction, intro and background as the next heading, and away from words meaning specific.
card.plain: It fires at the point where a document is about to start its first section, such as an introduction or background.
